batting.name: S Badrinath
batting.dismissal: c VRV Singh b IK Pathan

batting.name: ML Hayden
batting.dismissal: c DPMD Jayawardene b S Sreesanth

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c K Goel b PP Chawla

batting.name: SM Katich
batting.dismissal: c SB Jakati b L Balaji

batting.name: K Goel
batting.dismissal: c MS Gony b SB Jakati

balls.text: the slower short ball, Dhoni pulls towards deep midwicket for a single
Morkel once again mis-times the pull and takes a single
dropped by Abdulla at deep midwicket! Dhoni pulls powerfully but straight to Abdulla who runs in a few paces and drops a sitter
a full ball swinging into the left-hander, Morkel can't make proper contact but gives the strike back to Dhoni
Dhoni mis-times the pull to give the strike to Morkel

a friendly full toss outside off stump and Dhoni smashes the ball through cover to reach his fifty, he admitted earlier that his batting had been "pathetic" in the tournament, he's scored two fifties since then

caught! Hayden walks down the track and smashes the ball high, it;s really high but this time it hasn't gone far, Jayawardene settles under it at long-on and holds on to a well-judged catch, Sreesanth gives Hayden a small send off but he's copped a fearful hammering in the over
four more! Oh it came off the pad, Hayden tried to play a short arm jab but missed, the ball hit his thigh and went past the keeper to the third man boundary
ok Hayden's pushing for the hundred, Sreesanth feeds him a full toss and Hayden pulls over the midwicket boundary
how high has that gone? When it finally comes down the ball lands many feet outside the square leg boundary, Hayden's swinging with ferocity
Hayden walks down the track and swings again, this time he misses and Sangakkara collects, remember Sangakkara missed a stumping off Hayden early on
bizarre shot! Hayden moved across his stumps to a length delivery that was angling into him, he swiveled and pulled the ball with one hand over the fine leg boundary, stunning improvisation
Irfan was looking for the yorker, Hayden drives towards cover
too far on leg stump, fine leg is in the circle and Hayden flicks the ball past the fielder to the boundary, he had come out to take it on the full
full and straight from Irfan, Hayden forces it out towards long-on and runs two before the fielder can fire the throw in
full ball angling into the right-hander from round the wicket, Dhoni drives through cover
Hayden comes forward again and Irfan bowls a full toss, Hayden swivels and pulls and plays the ball to short fine leg
Hayden takes two steps down the track, Irfan bowls it wider outside off stump and passes the bat as Hayden swings
short this time and Dhoni goes on to the back foot in a flash and pulls to the midwicket boundary, Punjab are reeling here
he's not running for this one, it's gone miles over the straight boundary, VRV bowled a full ball, Dhoni got under it and swung mightily
Dhoni tries to go high and far over long off but doesn't time it, the fielder runs in from the boundary but can't reach the ball in time to take the catch
short and wide outside off stump, Dhoni swings his bat like a whip and clashes the ball over the point boundary, furious bat speed
a full toss and Dhoni swings his bat hard to dismiss the ball to the backward square leg boundary
Dhoni stays in his crease and slams the ball towards long-on
that's a tremendous hit! Hayden has got under that ball and lofted it on to the grassy banks over the square leg boundary, massive massive hit
another appeal for lbw as Hayden misses the reverse sweep, not out again
too short too wide and Hayden whacks it through cover for four more, he's turning it on here
fifty for Hayden! He gets there by stepping out and lofting the ball several rows beyond the midwicket boundary
loud appeal for lbw after Hayden misses the sweep, that hit him outside off stump
Hayden backs away to cut a flat ball just outside off stump, he misses and is nearly bowled
Hayden walks down the pitch and tries to blast over long-on, he mis-hits it and the ball falls short of the fielder running in from the boundary
short of a length and straight, Dhoni tries to pull but doesn't make proper contact
Hayden waits on the back foot and cuts the short ball hard to the fielder on the point boundary
full on leg stump, pushed for a single

Sreesanth strays down leg side, Dhoni tries to get out of the way and let the ball go and doesn't play a shot, the ball hits his pads and goes past the wicketkeeper to the boundary, the umpire says no runs because Dhoni wasn't playing a shot
good length ball cramping the left-hander for room, pushed off the back foot towards the off side
Dhoni steps out of his crease to defend a flatter delivery
too short on leg stump, Dhoni waits for it and paddles the ball past the fielder at short fine leg, four more
Dhoni steps out and works the ball off his pads through midwicket, he sprints back for the second
pushed off the back foot towards mid-on for a single
Hayden tries to sweep but gets beaten as the ball slides across him
pushed off the front foot towards point for one
Dhoni pulls out the reverse sweep and gets a single to short third man
he sweeps again, this time he's placed it fine and will get four, excellent shot, he's accelerating in case they go off the field again
Dhoni gets down on one knee and sweeps, he's hurting between the wickets, he wants two and gets it
Dhoni stays on the back foot and powers the ball through cover, he's hit that extremely hard
a full toss, driven on the front foot towards long on
Hayden hits the ball hard but straight to cover
Dhoni moves back into his crease and cuts the ball hard through the off side, two fielders converge on it in the deep but the ball finds the cover boundary
defended towards the bowler on the back foot
played off the back foot towards the bowler
pushed off the front foot towards point, Chawla bowls that quicker through the air
he steps out immediately but defends because he isn't to the pitch of the ball
and he's struck immediately! Chawla bowls a short one and Raina rocks back and pulls but makes contact with the bottom of his bat, he lofts the ball towards deep midwicket where Goel is waiting
Hayden comes out of his crease again but this time he mis-times the ball on the leg side
loud appeal for caught behind but Hayden had missed that
right he's back to thumping the ball down the ground, Hayden uses his feet to get to the pitch of the ball and drives hard and straight
Hayden tries to play the reverse sweep this time but can't pull it off
Raina moves forward and drives towards long off
Hayden gets down on one knee and plays the sweep towards long leg
full length outside off stump, Hayden gently drives the ball towards long off, gently by Hayden's standards
full and in the blockhole, Raina comes down hard on it and plays towards third man
short ball outside off stump, Raina stays in his crease and tries to chip it over the wicketkeeper but misses
muscled through midwicket for a single
Hayden moves on to the back foot and cuts through point for four, that's his first ball after the missed stumping
Raina cuts and cuts hard towards deep point

Sangakkara's missed a stumping! Hayden charged down the track and swung hard, he was beaten completely and was yards out of his crease, Sangakkara failed to collect and fumbled the second attempt as well, how costly will that prove? You do not let off the tournament's top-scorer!
Hayden strides forward and drives through cover point for two more
Raina cuts off the back foot towards point
full ball once again, Raina plays it towards point
bowled full in the blockhole, Hayden digs it out on the leg side
tossed up on off stump, driven towards long off for a single
full and wide outside off stump, Hayden reaches out but misses the ball
Hayden walks out again, he's doing it every ball! This time he misses a full toss and gets a faint edge that bounces well before it reaches Sangakkara

Hayden steps out again and mis-times the pull through square leg, Hayden's mis-timed shot however is good enough to reach the boundary, the Raina-Hayden duo is doing it again for Chennai, scoring at more than 10 an over
VRV angles the ball across the left-hander from over the wicket and beats Hayden who tries to smash the ball down the ground again
this time he's connected perfectly and the ball soars over the long-off boundary, Hayden came forward and freed his arms for that one, poor length from VRV
Hayden lofts the ball high over mid-off, he didn't connect cleanly though and the ball stops after pitching in the outfield
pushed off the back foot on the off side for a single

I'm not sure what Hayden was doing there, Yusuf bowled a slower one outside off stump, Hayden moved across his stumps to play on the leg but then changed his mind and tried to play on the off, he ended up not playing a shot
Hayden stays on the back foot and opens the face to steer the ball towards point, he doesn't find the gap that Raina did
nudged off the hips towards the leg side for one
Raina's found the smallest of gaps between two fielders at point! Yusuf bowled short and wide, Raina sat on the back foot and cut the ball fiercely through point
Raina welcomes him by walking out of his crease and drilling the ball past mid-off for four
Hayden walks out and swipes across the line at a good length delivery, Sreesanth beats him with his length and movement
Hayden tries to drive but gets an inside edge on the leg side, Hayden wants the run but Sreesanth runs quickly to the ball and prevents it

the slower ball and Hayden is too early into the shot down the ground, the ball goes in the air over the bowler, Yuvraj runs to his left from mid-off and dives full length to try and take the catch, he doesn't make the catch and appears to have injured his finger, he seems to be in a bit of pain
better length and the angle into the left-hander cramps Hayden who defends towards the bowler, did Sreesanth give Hayden a little stare?
Hayden winds up, tees off, and connects this time! The length was fuller and Hayden launched it over mid-off with a free swing of the bat
Hayden winds up and tees off! He was looking to whack that over long off but got beaten by the angle across the left-hander from Sreesanth

dropped but it was a tough chance! Raina made room to a full delivery and carved the ball towards point, it was traveling quickly when it reached the fielder who palmed the ball over his head, he took pace off it but the ball still reached the boundary
Irfan bowls full and straight, Hayden moves across but stays in his crease because Sangakkara is standing up, he pushes past the bowler for one
Irfan bowls a yorker just outside off and Raina steers it towards third man
the slower ball and Raina hits it uppishly towards mid-on, the ball bounces a few feet short of the fielder
this one is too wide and Raina crashes it through cover point for four more, he hit that very hard!
that's the first six! Raina gets under a length ball and lofts it over the long-on boundary, nothing wrong with that ball, it's the form of the man
too wide outside off stump, Raina reaches out and plays the square drive to the man at deep point
that's too wide outside off stump, Raina chases it in vain, first extra of the match
Hayden strides down the pitch and flays the ball hard and straight, Sreesanth can't stop it but mid-on can by diving full length to his right
Sreesanth slants the ball wider outside off stump, Hayden lets it go, that was rather wide
Hayden backs away towards leg to make room and swings the full ball through midwicket, such muscle in that shot and he's just swinging from the hip
Hayden tries to blast the ball through point but doesn't have enough room, he gets a bottom edge into the ground towards Sangakkara
Raina drops the ball short on the off side and calls Hayden through
good length on off and middle, Hayden defends on the leg side
one, two and wham! Hayden takes a couple of steps towards the bowler and smashes a length ball past mid-off for four, tremendous power
good length around off stump, shaping away from the left-hander, Hayden moves back and plays towards point
width offered outside off stump and Raina gets going by cutting the ball towards deep point
good length just outside off stump, Raina gets behind the line and blocks on the back foot

another first-baller! Irfan pitches short and wide outside off stump, Badrinath gets under it and upper cuts towards third man, VRV Singh barely has to move and takes the catch with ease, we've had so many first-ball ducks in the tournament
Yuvraj flicks the last ball off his pads to the fine leg boundary, Chennai have held their nerve to win a terrific match
Balaji bowls a yorker to Yuvraj and he digs it out, that's the game
lovely bowling, Balaji keeps his cool and bowls one in the blockhole, Jayawardene drives to long-off for one
full and in the blockhole, Yuvraj drives down the ground, that's not good enough
Jayawardene mis-times a low full toss towards long-on
Jayawardene backs away to make room and slices the full and wide ball over backward point for four
Jayawardene sweeps to deep square but once again they get only a single, what a marvelous over, just six off it, Raina's turned the game
Yuvraj tries to slog sweep but can't connect, the ball goes between his legs for a bye
Jayawardene lofts the ball towards long-off and Murali runs in and drops it, Yuvraj refused the second, he wants the strike
Raina slants down leg side and Yuvraj sweeps towards deep square, only one ...
Jayawardene charges but also mis-times the shot towards midwicket, the pressure's mounting on Punjab
bowled flat through the air angling into leg stump, Yuvraj misses the pull but the batsmen run a leg bye
Yuvraj mis-times a low full toss towards midwicket and gets only one, only nine off that over
Jayawardene edges the ball fine towards third man for a single, good over from Balaji
Jayawardene sees mid-off in the circle and he goes over the fielder, he's hit it high in the air and the ball plugs in the outfield after pitching, two more but Punjab need a boundary
full toss and Yuvraj muscles the ball to long-on for a single, five runs off the first three balls
sliced through point once again and that's Yuvraj's fifty

Yuvraj slices the full toss through cover point, the batsmen run one with ease, they want the second though after the fielder fumbles, Mahela is in trouble but Balaji collects but fails to break the stumps
Yuvraj drives firmly towards long-on for a single
Jayawardene tries to hit through cover but mis-times it, Raina's doing damage control after the Morkel over
Yuvraj backs away and hits the ball towards the off side
bowled into the block hole from round the wicket, Yuvraj digs it out on the leg side, there's a bit of a mix up between the batsmen but Yuvraj gets back in the end
played down the ground for a single
Jayawardene tries to swing through midwicket but misses
this has to be the biggest hit of the tournament, Yuvraj cleared his front foot out of the way and blitzed the ball over midwicket, I think that may have cleared the ground
that's too high, but the umpire says it's not high enough for a no-ball, Jayawardene swivels and gets a bit of bat on it towards fine leg, that's a marginal call
full toss and Yuvraj drives through the off side for one
full ball on the pads, Yuvraj picks it up and sends it racing to the midwicket boundary with a short-arm flick, he got enough elevation to beat the man at midwicket
super shot this, just reaching out and steering the full and wide ball down wide of gully and it also beats that poor man Gony running across down near the ropes
full outside off stump and Yuvraj clubs it down to long-on, he's really pushed hard by Jayawardene, huffing and puffing and coming back to the danger end
poor ball, very wide outside off stump so one run knocked off
comes out and hits it back hard to Murali, who misfields, and then Yuvraj sends Jayawardene back because the single was just not on

now that is a sensational start against the best offspinner in the world! A twinkled-toed Jayawardene two-steps out, making room for himself, and lofts Murali inside out over extra cover for a brilliant six, really a super shot that
flighted outside leg, cramps him for room, bunted away for one
comes out and takes it as a low full toss, driving to long-on
driven down the ground for a single
Jayawardene backs away to hit over the off side but gets a thick outside edge towards short third man, Bailey dives to his right and gets a hand on the ball
pushed towards mid-off for the quick single, 15 runs off the over
full ball angling into the right-hander, Jayawardene digs it out towards long-on, Yuvraj urges him back for the second
that's too short and Jayawardene pulls it over the square leg boundary with ease, effortless looking shot
Yuvraj backs away and drives through cover, he was trying to hit over the leg side but didn't have the room
Jayawardene makes a bit of room and drives in the air wide of Bailey at mid-off, he dives to his right to make the save
clever! Jayawardene waits for the length ball and then deftly tickles it past the wicketkeeper for four
Yuvraj comes forward and defends towards the bowler
he does it again, this time the reverse sweep goes to deep point for only one
Jayawardene fishes out the reverse sweep and places it past the man at short third man for four, delicate shot
swept towards deep square for one
Gony's dropped it! Yuvraj skied a mis-hit high towards long-on, Gony was on the boundary and he missed a pressure catch, the ball bounces once before going over the boundary
tossed up outside leg stump, Yuvraj tries to slog sweep against the turn but misses and gets hit on the pad
full ball outside off stump, Yuvraj opens the face and guides the ball to third man
short ball on leg stump, Jayawardene swivels and pulls towards long leg where Gony fields
Yuvraj opens the face and steers towards point
Jayawardene drops the ball with soft hands on the off side and runs the single
Yuvraj lofts down the ground but mis-times it, the ball falls safe over the bowler's head
Yuvraj came down the track, Balaji bowled it wide, too wide though

Balaji strikes first ball! It was short and wide, a pretty tame delivery, but Katich got under it and cut it straight to the fielder on the point boundary, Jakati took an easy catch, Katich didn't try to hit it hard, that was the problem
Katich swings the ball to deep midwicket to bring up his fifty, off only 24 balls
Katich tries to cut but misses
huge! Katich gets down on one knee and hammers the ball over the midwicket boundary, he picked that up from off stump and connected superbly with the slog sweep
Katich takes a step down and swats the ball hard over the bowler's head, Gony isn't the fastest mover and he has no chance on the boundary
driven firmly towards long off for a single
Yuvraj frees his arms and launches the ball over extra cover for a one-bounce four, lovely timing
Yuvraj sweeps again but this time it;s along the ground and there's a fielder on the square leg boundary
loud appeal for lbw after Yuvraj misses the pull, that hit him plumb in front but it might have pitched outside leg stump
Yuvraj nudges the ball towards midwicket, there's no one in the in field and he calls Katich back for the second
Yuvraj gets down on one knee and slog sweeps Murali powerfully over midwicket, that's his first six and it was flat
Katich moves back and across and flicks through square leg
Yuvraj stays in his crease and nudges the ball towards short fine leg
full length and Katich pushes it down the ground
Yuvraj leans forward and drives towards long-off for one
Katich moves back and across and cuts into the gap for a single
shorter length on off stump, Katich cuts towards point

Gony's caught it! Goel came out of his crease and lofted the ball towards long-on, Gony's had a couple of clumsy moments in the field but he got behind this one, the ball popped out of his hand but he held it on the second attempt
driven off the front foot towards point
Goel nudges the ball behind square on the leg side for one
Goel goes right back and defends on the off side
that's a wide down leg side
Katich moves back and pulls as the ball begins to spin across him, he picks up one because he's hit it in the gap
played off the back foot behind point for a single
Katich moves back and across to work the ball towards deep square leg
Goel stays in his crease and plays the ball behind square for one
slower ball to end the over, Katich defends on the off side, the Powerplay overs have come to an end, Punjab are four runs behind the par score
fuller length from Gony, Katich drives straight and Gony gets his large shoe in the way of the shot
three in a row! Gony goes round the wicket but Katich merely picks long-on as his spot and slams the ball over the boundary
and this is the second! Katich gets under a fuller ball and lofts it straighter over midwicket, it goes the distance
Katich moves forward, picks up a length ball and lifts it over the square leg boundary, that ball had a lot of airtime ... first six of the innings
good length on off stump, Goel pushes towards cover and runs the single
Goel backs away and tries to loft over extra cover, he mis-times it but the ball falls short of mid-off
Katich tries to hit over cover but mis-times the shot
Goel moves right across his stumps and tries to work the ball behind square,he doesn't make proper contact
superb ball, it bounces sharply off a length and seams away from the left-hander, Goel fends off the back foot and gets beaten
good length on off stump, Goel moves forward and plays towards point
Goel stands tall and lofts the ball over point, didn't look convincing but he'll get two
full and straight, Katich moves across and flicks the ball through midwicket
Morkel bowls a superb yorker which Katich plays back to the bowler
in the blockhole but Katich manages to squeeze it out towards fine leg
width offered outside off stump, Katich waits for it and drives the length ball hard over the infield at cover, super shot that
this time Katich tries to cut but gets beaten
Katich forces the full ball off his pads through midwicket for four, it was the slower one from Morkel but Katich connected well
Goel tries to drive but gets beaten by the movement and angle across him
edged, dropped and four! Goel slashes and gets a thick edge which flies between the keeper and Hayden at first slip, it was Dhoni's catch but he bailed out of the attempt after initially going for it
Goel moves back and across and plays the ball towards the leg side
big bounce from Tyagi from short of a length, Goel defends on the back foot and gets hit on the gloves
Goel tries to launch the ball over the off side but gets beaten by the extra bounce, Tyagi's quite tall
he angles the ball across the left hander and gets it to bounce steeply, Goel lets it go
Katich closes the face once again and gets a leading edge over cover, Morkel completes an excellent first over
now Katich swings wildly at one outside off stump and tries to hit towards midwicket, he too misses
good length outside off stump, Goel opens the face and plays the ball to third man
Goel plays a full ball towards the bowler
a second-baller! Sohal backs a long way towards leg to hit through the off side, Morkel keeps it on a length and straight and hits leg stump after Sohal doesn't connect with his swing
is that another first-baller? Sohal backs away and swings wildly, he skies the ball high in the air down the ground, Gony makes a hash of judging the catch and the ball falls safe
